sourceSpecificLaw.parameterSharing: One dMin world-distance value and identical function for catalog salmon and runtime cucumber, in every action/frame and continuously in root orientation. Declare units/conversion, source d0 and selected dMin in recipe.
sourceSpecificLaw.C1Derivation: For f>=0 depth is constant d0. For f<0 depth is d0-(d0-dMin)f^2 and its derivative -2(d0-dMin)f tends to0 at f=0. Values and first derivative agree at the side boundary. For this source depth at S/front and E/W sides is d0; at N/rear it is dMin.
